name: adaptive-vscode-icons
description: A dynamic icon theme that converts any icon set to monochrome using your system accent color

commands.title: Adaptive Icons: Refresh from System Accent
Adaptive Icons: Set Custom Accent Color
Adaptive Icons: Set Icon Theme Source Path

adaptiveIcons.accentColor.description: Override the system accent color with a custom hex color (e.g., #3daee9). Leave empty to use system accent.

adaptiveIcons.watchSystemAccent.description: Automatically update icons when the system accent color changes

adaptiveIcons.watchInterval.description: How often to check for system accent changes (in milliseconds)

adaptiveIcons.iconThemeSourcePath.description: Path to the source icon theme (e.g., a-wl-file-icon-vscode). The icons will be converted to monochrome using the accent color.

adaptiveIcons.autoReload.description: Automatically reload VS Code when the accent color changes to update icons. Required because VS Code caches icon themes.
